prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1158; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a two-vehicle collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left and was struck by the claimant's vehicle traveling straight through on the cross street. Police report requested. Claimant reports left shoulder pain and has not yet seen a physician.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant confirmed they are not represented by an attorney and stated they are handling the claim directly. Explained the claims process, the need for medical documentation, and the option to seek independent advice. Claimant reports ongoing shoulder pain with limited range of motion when reaching overhead.

Entry 3: Received the responding officer's report. It notes the insured stated they had a green arrow for the left turn, while the claimant stated their light was also green. Witness statement is pending. Scene photos from both vehicles reviewed and show front-end damage to the insured vehicle and driver-side door damage to the claimant vehicle.

Entry 4: Claimant provided a copy of an urgent care visit record. Diagnosis listed as a strained left shoulder with recommendation for physical therapy and a follow-up in two weeks. Medical bills and wage loss documentation requested from the claimant. Claimant indicated they will send these when available.

Entry 5: Liability review in progress. Based on the available evidence, fault allocation remains disputed and the witness statement is still outstanding. Set reminder to follow up with the claimant on physical therapy status and to confirm receipt of the medical bills. Reserve reviewed and will be updated once liability and medical records are finalized.
